metadata.description: Sample recurring invoke pattern for UC-005/006. Prefer Logic App Recurrence or Timer Function that POSTs a TRIAGE_RUN command to the Foundry agent Responses endpoint. Do not run APScheduler inside the hosted agent container.
Foundry hosted agent Responses invoke URL (from azd / portal).
Must match specialist config interval_hours stored in Blob (UC-006).
Bearer token or API key used by your Foundry invoke path.

logicAppGuidance.value: Create a Logic App with Recurrence trigger (Frequency=Hour, Interval=intervalHours). Action: HTTP POST to foundryAgentInvokeUrl with body = TRIAGE_RUN specialist_id=... Align Interval with Blob specialist config.mode=recurring and interval_hours.
